source: 2026-11-03 market-foundation (gameplay-programmer): four markets, the 8 existing goods tagged per design/proposals/2026-11-03-four-markets.md section 1.1. base_value = mean of <good>_sell over every planet that defines it in data/planets.json and data/systems.json (rounded), computed once here; share volume = units sold x base_value. common_raws: energy, food, ore do not count toward the active-market rule or cross-load (summary R5). 2026-11-03 goods-workshops: the 11 new goods tagged and valued the same way (mean of <good>_sell over data/goods.json planet_prices; crafted goods have one price). 2026-11-06 T239: energy leaves Military and is the only common raw (adds no share); food and ore count for their branches; renames and the starters powder and blooms (base_value = rounded mean of <good>_sell as before; ore 13 to 11 because Flintmoor now buys ore at a low price).
